# gyro_security_group (Resource)

Security group (AWS security group model) for servers with the Network Firewall add-on: a reusable, stateful list of ALLOW rules. Attach it with gyro_server_security_groups (up to 5 groups per server). The resource owns all rules of the group; a group without outbound rules does not restrict outbound traffic. Destroy fails while the group is attached.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reusable allow lists (AWS security group model). Stateful: replies to allowed connections pass automatically.
resource "gyro_security_group" "web" {
  name        = "web"
  description = "HTTP/HTTPS for everyone"

  rule {
    type = "http"
  }
  rule {
    type = "https"
  }
}

resource "gyro_security_group" "admin" {
  name = "admin"

  rule {
    type        = "ssh"
    source      = ["203.0.113.10/32"]
    description = "office"
  }
  rule {
    type   = "custom_tcp"
    port   = "8000-8100"
    source = ["198.51.100.0/24"]
  }
  # outbound: a group without outbound rules does not restrict outbound traffic
  rule {
    direction = "out"
    type      = "all"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name (2-64 characters, unique in the account). Renaming keeps the group.

### Optional

- `confirm_trial` (Boolean) A rule change that could cut SSH/RDP access on an attached server runs as a 5 minute trial; true (default) confirms it right after apply.
- `description` (String) Up to 255 characters.
- `rule` (Block List) Allow rules (inbound and outbound). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--rule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group id (sg-xxxxxxxx).
- `servers` (List of Number) Servers the group is attached to.
- `status` (String) unused, applying, active or trial.

<a id="nestedblock--rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule`

Required:

- `type` (String) One of ssh, http, https, rdp, mysql, postgresql, mssql, redis, mongodb, smtp, smtps, imaps, dns_udp, dns_tcp, all_tcp, all_udp, all_icmp, all, custom_tcp, custom_udp. The type fixes protocol and port; custom_tcp / custom_udp take port.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Up to 60 characters.
- `direction` (String) in (to the servers) or out (new connections from the servers; source = remote address).
- `port` (String) For custom_tcp / custom_udp: 8080 or 8000-8100. Computed for the other types.
- `source` (List of String) IPv4 / CIDR list; default ["0.0.0.0/0"] (anywhere).

Read-Only:

- `rule_id` (String) Rule id assigned by the API (gfr-xxxxxxxx).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_security_group.web sg-1a2b3c4d
```
